words.gloss: he should cause to be seized

hindi: यदि वे जैसा कहा गया है वैसा करें, तो उन्हें पकड़वाए नहीं।
english: If they should do as stated, he should not cause them to be seized.
notes: grāhayet: causative of √grah, literally 'cause to seize/take'; the sense in this context (instigate, win over, intercept) is not fixed by the line, so the literal 'cause to be seized' is kept.

words.gloss: he should cause to be seized

hindi: अथवा शक्तिहीनों को पकड़वाए।
english: Or he should cause the powerless to be seized.
notes: grāhayet: causative of √grah, literally 'cause to seize/take'; the sense in this context (instigate, win over, intercept) is not fixed by the line, so the literal 'cause to be seized' is kept.

words.gloss: one who has reached the state of a trusted one

hindi: विश्वासपात्र की स्थिति को प्राप्त हुआ व्यक्ति कहे कि इसकी स्वयं की रक्षा मुख्य से की जानी चाहिए।
english: One who has reached the state of a trusted one should say that this one's own self must be protected from the chief.
notes: The syntax of the line is loose: mukhyāt may be 'from the chief' (taken here) or 'on the chief's account'; asya may refer to the man addressed. āpta-bhāva is taken literally as 'state of a trusted one' (āpta = trusted).

words.gloss: for the injury of the chief
he should cause to be seized

hindi: अब, मुख्य को हानि पहुँचाने के लिए भेजे गए शत्रु के आदेश को दोनों से वेतन पाने वाला पकड़वाए।
english: Now, the enemy's message sent for the injury of the chief, one paid by both should cause to be seized.
notes: grāhayet: causative of √grah, literally 'cause to seize/take'; the sense in this context (instigate, win over, intercept) is not fixed by the line, so the literal 'cause to be seized' is kept. Here the object is the message, so 'intercept' is a possible sense. atha is rendered 'now' (alternatively 'or'/'then').

words.gloss: those having the power of energy

hindi: अथवा उत्साह-शक्ति वालों के पास यह भेजे: "अमुक का राज्य ले लो, हमारी सन्धि जैसी स्थित है।"
english: Or he should send [word] to those having the power of energy: "Seize the kingdom of so-and-so; our treaty stands as it was."

text_flags.why: possible: the e-text splits yathā + asthita (asthita would mean unstable); the sense and the usual phrase suggest yathā-sthita, "as it stands". Both give the same sandhi form yathāsthito.

notes: preṣayet takes an accusative (utsāha-śaktimataḥ) and no stated object; 'send [word] to' is supplied, the alternative being 'send those having the power of energy [with the message]'. utsāha-śakti is rendered by the glossary's 'power of energy'. 'yathā.asthito' is read yathā-sthitaḥ 'as it stands' (see text_flags).

words.gloss: they should cause to be seized

hindi: तब गुप्तचर शत्रुओं में पकड़वाएँ।
english: Then the secret agents should cause [them] to be seized among the enemies.
notes: grāhayet: causative of √grah, literally 'cause to seize/take'; the sense in this context (instigate, win over, intercept) is not fixed by the line, so the literal 'cause to be seized' is kept. para is taken as 'enemy' (it could also be 'others'); the object is not stated.

words.gloss: they should cause to be destroyed

hindi: एक के स्कन्धावार, रसद अथवा सहायक सेना का घात करवाएँ।
english: Of one [of them] they should cause the camp, the supply line or the reinforcements to be destroyed.
notes: ghātayeyuḥ: causative of √han, 'cause to be struck down/killed'; 'destroyed' is used because the objects are camp, supply line, reinforcements. 'of one [of them]' supplies the partitive.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √brū, m. nom. pl.

hindi: दूसरों में मित्रता प्रकट करते हुए वे गुप्त रूप से भड़काएँ: "तुम इनके द्वारा मारे जाने योग्य हो।"
english: Professing friendship among the others, they should secretly instigate: "You are to be killed by these."
notes: eteṣām is a genitive of the agent with the gerundive ('by these'); the alternative is 'you are to be got killed of these', i.e. one of these is to be killed through you. upajapeyuḥ: the glossary's upajāpa 'secret instigation'. bruvāṇāḥ 'professing' is literally 'saying/speaking'.

hindi: जिसका कोई प्रमुख वीर पुरुष, हाथी या घोड़ा मर जाए, गूढ़ पुरुषों द्वारा मारा जाए या हर लिया जाए, गुप्तचर एक-दूसरे द्वारा आहत कहें।
english: Of whomever an eminent brave man, elephant or horse should die, or be killed by secret agents, or be carried off, the secret agents should say [it is] injured by one another.
notes: The line has no correlative for yasya; the structure is kept literal. The instrumental gūḍha-puruṣaiḥ is placed with hanyeta (killed by secret agents) but could also cover hriyeta. 'it is' is supplied.

hindi: तब अभियुक्त को यह आदेश भेजे: "और करो, तब पण का शेष प्राप्त करोगे।"
english: Then he should send a message to the accused: "Do more; then you will obtain the remainder of the paṇa."

text_flags.why: typo: doubled e in śeeṣam; the Devanagari shows the same doubling (शेएषम्)

notes: abhiśastasya is a genitive ('of the accused'), taken here as 'to the accused'; the alternative is a message 'belonging to' the accused. paṇa (stake, wage, agreed payment) is left untranslated; the sense is uncertain.

words.gloss: they should cause to be seized

hindi: उसे दोनों से वेतन पाने वाले पकड़वाएँ।
english: Those paid by both should cause that to be seized.
notes: grāhayet: causative of √grah, literally 'cause to seize/take'; the sense in this context (instigate, win over, intercept) is not fixed by the line, so the literal 'cause to be seized' is kept. 'that' presumably refers to the message of the preceding unit.

hindi: फूट पड़े हुओं में से किसी एक को प्राप्त करे।
english: Among the divided, he may obtain any one.

words.gloss: the commander of the army, the prince and those moving with the army

hindi: उससे सेनापति, कुमार और सेना के साथ चलने वाले समझाए गए।
english: By that, the commander of the army, the prince and those moving with the army are explained.
notes: The compound is ambiguous: senā-pati-kumāra-daṇḍa-cārin may be a dvandva of three persons (commander, prince, army-goers), as taken here, or 'those moving with the army of the commander and prince'. daṇḍa is taken as 'army' (the glossary's prakṛti sense); cārin is literally 'going/moving'.

hindi: और सन्धि से सम्बन्धित भेद का प्रयोग करे।
english: And he should apply dissension relating to a treaty.
notes: sāndhikam is taken as an adjective of bhedam ('treaty-related dissension'); it could instead be a noun object (a man concerned with treaty, to whom dissension is applied).

hindi: इस प्रकार भेद का कर्म।
english: Thus, the action of dissension.
notes: iti here opens a closing statement of the topic (not a quotation); the copula is not supplied.

words.gloss: by weapon, fire, poison and so on

hindi: तीक्ष्ण, उत्साही, व्यसनी अथवा स्थित शत्रु वाले को गूढ़ पुरुष शस्त्र, अग्नि, विष आदि से समाप्त करें, अथवा सुगमता से उनमें से कोई एक।
english: Secret agents should dispatch the fierce, the energetic, the one afflicted by vyasana, or the one with a standing enemy, with weapon, fire, poison and so on; or, from ease, any one of them.
notes: sādhayeyuḥ literally 'should accomplish'; with a person as object the sense 'dispose of, finish off' is taken. tīkṣṇa is read as an adjective of the target here ('fierce'), whereas in the next unit it is the agent called tīkṣṇa. vyasanin: calamity or vice, both possible. sthita-śatru: bahuvrīhi, 'one whose enemy stands (firm/at hand)'; sense uncertain. rasa = poison (glossary). anyatamaḥ is nominative, so teṣām is read as 'of them', the secret agents (alternatively the means: weapon, fire, poison).

hindi: क्योंकि तीक्ष्ण अकेला ही शस्त्र, विष और अग्नि से समाप्त कर दे।
english: For the assassin, alone, may dispatch with weapon, poison and fire.
notes: tīkṣṇa is the agent class (glossary: assassin); ekaḥ may also be read as "one" (a single assassin). sādhayet: see unit 53.

words.gloss: the action of the whole combination

hindi: यह सब के समूह का कर्म करता है, अथवा विशिष्ट करता है।
english: This one does the action of the whole combination, or a more distinguished [action].
notes: sandoha is literally 'a mass, collection'; 'combination' of all the means. viśiṣṭam is taken as agreeing with an understood karma.

hindi: इस प्रकार उपायों का चार का समूह।
english: Thus, the group of four means.
notes: iti opens a closing statement (not a quotation); the copula is not supplied.

hindi: और इसका एक-एक पूर्व सबसे हल्का है।
english: And each earlier one of this [group] is the lightest.
notes: The repeated pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ means 'each earlier one'. laghiṣṭha is the superlative of laghu 'light'.

hindi: सान्त्व एक गुण वाला है।
english: Conciliation has one guṇa.
notes: guṇa is kept as a Sanskrit term; in this series it is a count (one, two, three, four), i.e. the number of components, literally 'fold'.

hindi: दान दो गुण वाला है, सान्त्व जिसके पहले है।
english: Gift has two guṇas, with conciliation before it.

hindi: भेद तीन गुण वाला है, सान्त्व और दान जिसके पहले हैं।
english: Dissension has three guṇas, with conciliation and gift before it.

words.gloss: preceded by conciliation, gift and dissension

hindi: दण्ड चार गुण वाला है, सान्त्व, दान और भेद जिसके पहले हैं।
english: Force has four guṇas, with conciliation, gift and dissension before it.
notes: daṇḍa as an upāya = force (glossary).

words.gram: pres. part. mid. abhi-√yuj, m. loc. pl.

hindi: इस प्रकार आक्रमण करने वालों के विषय में कहा गया।
english: Thus [this] is said regarding those who attack.
notes: iti opens a closing statement (not a quotation); 'this is' is supplied. abhiyuñjāna 'attacking' (cf. abhiyoktṛ, attacker); the locative is rendered 'regarding'.

words.gloss: among those standing on their own ground

hindi: परन्तु अपनी भूमि पर स्थित लोगों में वे ही उपाय हैं।
english: But among those standing on their own ground, those very means [apply].
notes: 'ta' is te before eva (sandhi). sva-bhūmiṣṭha: 'own' is taken as their own (those who remain in their own territory); 'apply' is supplied by bracket.

hindi: परन्तु विशेष है।
english: But the distinction [is].
notes: The sentence continues in the next unit; the copula is supplied.

words.gloss: of those standing on their own ground

hindi: अपनी भूमि पर स्थित लोगों में से किसी एक के पास माल के भण्डारों द्वारा जाने-पहचाने मुख्य दूतों को बार-बार भेजे।
english: He should repeatedly send to any one of those standing on their own ground chief envoys recognized by storehouses of goods.
notes: The phrase paṇya-agāraiḥ abhijñātān is obscure; rendered literally ('recognized by storehouses of goods'); a sense such as 'introduced through merchants' houses' is possible but not asserted. The genitive anyatamasya is taken as 'to any one of'.

hindi: वे इसे सन्धि अथवा शत्रु की हिंसा में लगाएँ।
english: They should engage him in a treaty or in harm to the enemy.
notes: 'ta' is te before enam (sandhi). para is taken as 'enemy'; 'others' is possible.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. neg. pra-ti-√pad, m. acc. sg.

hindi: जो स्वीकार न करे, उसके विषय में वे घोषित करें: "हमारी सन्धि की जा चुकी है।"
english: As to him who does not comply, they should announce: "Our treaty is made."
notes: The accusative apratipadyamānam is placed loosely ('as to him'); it may also be the person informed or reported. naḥ sandhiḥ is 'our treaty' (a treaty with us).

words.gloss: they should cause to pass over

hindi: उसे दोनों से वेतन पाने वाले दूसरों तक पहुँचाएँ: "यह तुम्हारा राजा दुष्ट है।"
english: Those paid by both should cause him to pass over to the others: "This king of yours is wicked."
notes: saṅkrāmayeyuḥ literally 'cause to cross over, transfer'; what passes over (the man, or the report about him) is not stated, and itareṣām is genitive ('of the others', read as 'to'). duṣṭa literally 'spoiled, corrupt'.

hindi: अथवा जिसको जिससे भय, वैर या द्वेष हो, उसे उससे विलग करें: "यह तुम्हारे शत्रु से सन्धि करता है, पहले ही तुम्हें छल रहा है, जल्दी सन्धि कर लो और इसके निग्रह में प्रयत्न करो।"
english: Or, whoever has fear, enmity or hatred from whomever, him they should split from that one: "This one makes a treaty with your enemy; beforehand he outwits you; make peace more quickly, and strive in his restraint."
notes: The first clause is literal and loose (yasya ... yasmāt ... taṃ tasmāt). purā with the present is rendered 'beforehand' ('formerly' is the usual sense; the line does not settle it). sandhīyasva has a passive-looking middle form; 'make peace' (with the speaker or the third party) is the rendering. nigraha: restraint, capture or punishment; 'restraint' used. te śatruṇā: 'with your enemy'.

words.gloss: by bringing in a bride and by marriage

hindi: अथवा आवाह और विवाह द्वारा सम्बन्ध बनाकर असम्बद्धों को विलग करे।
english: Or, having made a connection by bringing in [a bride] and by marriage, he should split the unconnected.
notes: āvāha (bringing the bride to the groom's house) and vivāha (marriage, giving in marriage) are taken literally; the pair is often read as giving and taking of daughters, which the line does not say. The text spells samyogam and asamyuktān with m (for saṃ-).

words.gloss: by neighbours, forest chiefs, members of their family and princes in disfavour
he should cause to be destroyed

hindi: सामन्तों, आटविकों, उनके कुल के लोगों और निकाले गए राजकुमारों द्वारा इनके राज्यों का घात करवाए, अथवा सार्थों, व्रजों और वनों का, अथवा आगे बढ़ी हुई सेना का।
english: By neighbours, forest chiefs, members of their family and princes in disfavour he should cause the kingdoms of these to be destroyed, or the caravans, cattle-stations and forests, or the army that has advanced.
notes: vraja is literally a cattle-pen or station; 'cattle-stations' is a literal rendering. aṭavī here is read as 'forests' in a list of places; the glossary's 'forest tribes' sense is also possible. The objects after vā are taken as further objects of ghātayet. sāmanta = neighbour (bordering ruler).

hindi: और परस्पर एक-दूसरे का आश्रय लेने वाले इनके जाति-संघ छिद्रों पर प्रहार करें, और गुप्तचर अग्नि, विष और शस्त्र से।
english: And the jāti-saṅghas of these, relying on one another, should strike at the weak points; and secret agents, with fire, poison and weapon.
notes: '[should strike]' is not repeated for gūḍhāḥ in the English; the verb is carried over from prahareyuḥ. jāti-saṅgha is kept as a term (saṅgha of birth/kind). apāśraya: refuge, support. rasa = poison (glossary).

words.gloss: like a swallower of a snare
he should cause to be killed
in [a body] mixed with the enemy

hindi: और चतुर शठ शत्रुओं को, जाल निगलने वाले के समान, किए हुए योगों से, शत्रु से मिली हुई में, विश्वास और चारे से मरवाए।
english: And the crafty one should cause the enemies, like swallowers of a snare, to be killed by contrivances put into practice, in [a body] mixed with the enemy, by trust and by bait.
notes: vītaṃsa-gilavat is obscure: vītaṃsa is a snare or hook for catching, gila a swallower; the likeness is to creatures swallowing the bait. para-miśrāyām is a feminine locative with no stated noun; '[a body]' is a bracketed placeholder and the reading is doubtful. yoga = contrivance (Book 12 sense). Metre: both lines have 16 syllables.
